analyst.text: Boston lost by a point at 2-14 Sacramento on Saturday, their third straight loss, with Jayson Tatum resting and Derrick White (shoulder) and Mitchell Robinson (illness) out; this is the second night of that back-to-back. Golden State are 0-5 on their just-finished road trip but have won six straight at home, and Draymond Green is off the injury report, though Stephen Curry remains out. Boston's slide and fatigue make this closer than the records; the angle leans slightly towards Golden State at home.
